entities.name: Maysin
observations: Corn-silk flavonoid tested for effects on human PC-3 prostate cancer cells.

entities.name: PC-3
observations: Human androgen-independent prostate cancer cell line used in maysin apoptosis study.

entities.name: PMID:25445226
observations: Lee et al., 2014, reported that corn-silk maysin induced apoptosis in PC-3 cells, with mitochondrial membrane-potential depolarization and reduced Bcl-2 and pro-caspase-3 expression; abstract-level evidence did not establish all canonical intrinsic-pathway steps.

entities.name: Maysin PC-3 apoptosis
observations: In PC-3 cells, maysin reduced viability dose-dependently (87% at 200 μg/mL) and induced apoptosis by Annexin V/PI and TUNEL/DNA-fragmentation assays; mitochondrial depolarization and reduced Bcl-2/pro-caspase-3 supported mitochondrial involvement.
